## New in this release

### Absences
- **Tap an absence** to see all its details: date and time, duration, whether it's excused, the excuse status, the reason and the note. Parents also see who entered it (you, another parent, or a teacher by their short name) and when.
- **Delete an absence** you reported, from its details, as long as the school still allows changing it.
- **Upcoming absences show up:** the list now reaches the end of the school year, so absences you report in advance are listed too.

### Fixed
- **Reporting absences works** (confirmed with alpha.3 on a password account and an ID Austria account).

### Alpha
- Test build with the Debug screen (menu → Debug). It installs over 0.4.6-alpha.3 and is replaced by the next beta.
